Strongest NEXT source to extend the issue. Filenames embed data year (d) and creation date (c), e.g. StormEvents_details-ftp_v1.0_dYYYY_cYYYYMMDD.csv.gz - scrape the directory index to resolve the latest c-stamp per year (c-date changes on revision; take the newest). DAMAGE_PROPERTY/DAMAGE_CROPS are TEXT with K/M/B suffixes ('2.5K','10.00M') - parse in staging, not landing. STATE_FIPS + CZ_FIPS need padding/joining; CZ_TYPE='Z' means NWS forecast zone (not a county FIPS) vs 'C'=county - don't blindly join Z-rows to county FIPS. Three files must be joined on EVENT_ID. Mirror also on source.coop (Earth Genome) if NCEI FTP is flaky.

Adds a 'bearing' field and computed landing geometry the NTI base file lacks (good for spatial viz of impact points). It is a DERIVED mirror, not the primary source — onboard NTI as the system of record and use this only to enrich landing coordinates/bearing.

Use the flat data.ransomware.live mirror for bulk loads — don't paginate the REST API (it's rate-limited and meant for lookups). Use the /raw/refs/heads/master/ URL (web HTML page is 403 to WebFetch; raw blob is fine).

IMPORTANT: use the keyless bulk-download ZIP (bulks-faostat.fao.org), NOT the FAOSTAT developer API — the API now requires a JWT bearer token that expires every 60 minutes. ZIP serves clean from S3/CloudFront (HTTP 200). This is CHRONIC hunger (Prevalence of Undernourishment, Food Insecurity Experience Scale, dietary energy supply) — annual and slow-moving, complements IPC's acute crisis data. Country codes are FAO's M49-based 'Area Code' + 3-letter 'Area Code (M49)'; map to ISO3 for joins. Aggregates ('World', 'Africa') are mixed into the rows — filter them out in staging. There's a separate FAOSTAT data-source already scouted as intl_fao_faostat — recommend this as the food-security-specific sub-doma

Directly answers 'global debt crisis' for the countries actually in crisis. USE THE BULK CSV, not the API, for the full panel. The Data API v2 path is /v2/sources/6/country/{ISO3}/series/{SERIES}/time/all?format=json and it explodes on the Counterpart-Area dimension — a single Ghana+DT.DOD.DECT.CD query returned 19,152 rows (counterpart x time) and ~6,384 pages. For a clean country panel filter Counterpart-Area=WLD (all creditors). Series codes are WDI-style (e.g. DT.DOD.DECT.CD = total external debt stocks; DT.TDS.DECT.CD = total debt service). Only low- and middle-income countries are covered (no high-income/G7 debtors). Years run 1970-2032; 2025+ are projection/null placeholders — drop

'place_id' is FHFA's own code, not raw FIPS for every level — derive FIPS for county/tract, ZIP for ZIP series; map MSA codes to CBSA. Some early periods have nulls/HPI=100 base. tables.name: FBI NICS Firearm Background Checks (Data Liberation Project CSV mirror)
tables.one_liner: Cleanest structured gun-commerce signal in this issue: state x month firearm demand 1998-present, the standard proxy for gun sales and the volume side of the ATF commerce story - loads in one pull. FBI publishes ONLY as PDF; this mirror is the de-facto structured version (DLP converts the PDF monthly). Verified live: HTTP 200, 1,411,489 bytes, header confirmed. Wide format with 24 check-type count columns + totals; state name is the join key (map to FIPS in staging). HARD CAVEAT for any narrative: a background check is NOT a gun sale (permit rechecks, multi-gun checks, CCW renewals inflate counts) - proxy, not a sales count. Pin commit/date in _SRC_SHA256 since the file is append-mostly but historical rows can be revised.

tables.name: IPC Global Acute Food Insecurity Country Data
tables.one_liner: This IS the famine angle. Quantifies catastrophic food insecurity (Phase 5/Famine) and emergency (Phase 4) populations for Sudan and Darfur down to the analysis-area level — the data behind the 'famine confirmed in El Fasher/Kadugli' headlines, with official projections. Direct stable HDX download URLs (e.g. .../download/ipc_global_national_long_latest.csv) — no HDX login or API key needed; curl with a normal User-Agent works (the human-facing dataset PAGE 403s automated fetchers, but the CKAN resource download URLs are open). Choose granularity: national, level1 (admin1 — gives Darfur states), or area (IPC analysis units incl. El Fasher town, IDP camps). 'long' = tidy one-row-per-phase (recommended for Snowflake); 'wide' pivots phases to columns. Country code is ISO3 in the 'Country' column. Phase 5 = Famine — Sudan latest shows 134,808 (current) projected to 199,713. Percentage column

tables.name: CNS North Korea Missile Test Database (Nuclear Threat Initiative / James Martin Center for Nonproliferation Studies)
tables.one_liner: Directly answers the issue — it is THE authoritative chronology of every DPRK missile flight test 1984-present (missile family, outcome, apogee/range, launch site geocoded), which is exactly the CSIS/NTI missile-test data the angle asks for, and it is the cleanest onboardable form of it. Header row is row 2 (row 1 is blank); 'Missile Tests' sheet dims A1:S305 with first real data at row 3. 19 columns incl. F1 id, Date, Date Entered/Updated, Launch Time (UTC), Missile Name, Missile Type (SRBM/MRBM/IRBM/ICBM/SLV), Launch Agency, Facility Name, Facility Location, Other Name, Facility Latitude, Facility Longitude, Landing Location (mostly text/'Unknown'), Apogee, Distance Travelled, Confirmation Status, Test Outcome, Additional Information, Source(s). Many numeric-ish fields ('Apogee','Distance Travelled','Landing Location') are free-text incl. 'Unknown' — keep as TEXT in landing, parse in s

tables.name: Freedom in the World — All Data (aggregate + category scores)
tables.one_liner: The canonical annual freedom-status scorecard with disaggregated political-rights / civil-liberties sub-scores back to 2013 (status back to 1973) — the second pillar of any backsliding story, and directly downloadable now. Direct .xlsx (verified live, 488KB, no login). Hard-coded year-folder in the URL changes each release — parameterize it or scrape the report page for the current link. Header rows are messy (merged cells, two header rows; sub-indicator codes A1..G4 across columns) — read with pandas skiprows/header=[0,1] then flatten. Country names need a name->ISO crosswalk to get a clean COUNTRY join key (no ISO column). The 1973-2024 ratings file is a separate workbook with one sheet per year-block; the 'All Data 2013-2024' file is the one with full category scores. Commercial-use restriction matters for the publishing layer.
